svg.title: Held-out SDE vs ODE success across all six v4 methods
svg.desc: Ten-seed held-out SDE and ODE success rates (128 episodes per task and mode) for all six training arms in Q3 v4, with fixed A1 start and critic-free A2 specialist reference lines.
svg.text: Distillation beats short BC, trails specialists, and drops sharply in ODE.
MEASURED | 10 seeds (101–110) | 128 held-out episodes/task | Small marks: individual seeds, large marks: 10-seed mean
Held-out success rate (%) across 128 fixed reset seeds (200000–200127)
Reference lines are single fixed policies (one A1 start, one specialist bank), not ten independently trained teacher banks.
